payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether Outfall 001 monitoring is required continuously every month or only when authorized event-type discharges occur. The packet's sole operative-clause excerpt (page 3, part_i) lists authorized discharge types but is truncated and contains no monitoring-frequency or event-triggered monitoring language. Cover-page dates and the FY2025 window establish temporal scope only. The packet's known_missing_information explicitly notes that NODI code legends are absent. Without monitoring-schedule text, a complete conditional-monitoring clause, or NODI legends, the packet cannot establish that conditional monitoring applies (ACCEPT) nor that continuous monthly monitoring is required instead (REJECT). Preferring unsupported uncertainty to unsupported semantic closure, UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
